title: 100 Tumblehome Way Vacation Rental
meta_description: 100 Tumblehome Way is a 4.00 bedroom, 4.00 bathroom vacation rental.
description_expanded: Description Welcome to 100 Tumblehome Way Nestled within the gated WaterSound West Beach community, 100 Tumblehome Way offers the perfect blend of style, comfort, and convenience. With a 6-passenger electric cart, four adult bikes, and pet-friendly accommodations, this elegant home provides an inviting setting for families seeking a peaceful coastal retreat along 30A.Property Highlights 6-Passenger Street-Legal Electric Cart Included 4 Adult Cruiser Bikes Included in Rental Pet Friendly (Additional Fee Applies) Parking for 2 Vehicles Garage Access for Electric Cart Only Screened Porch Built-In Outdoor Natural Gas Grill Exterior Hot/Cold Shower 2-Minute Bike Ride to the Pool and Beach Boardwalk 4-Minute Electric Cart Ride to Big Chill Restaurants and Shops 10-Minute Electric Cart Ride to Seaside Experience the Home Escape to WaterSound West Beach on Florida’s Emerald Coast, where 100 Tumblehome Way provides a serene coastal retreat designed for family getaways. Blending classic European style with relaxed coastal comfort, this home offers both elegance and ease in every detail. The main level welcomes you with an open-concept design that unites the kitchen, dining, and living areas into one inviting space. The fully equipped kitchen features stainless steel appliances, granite countertops, and bar seating for four. The adjoining dining table seats ten, making it ideal for shared family meals. The living area offers a cozy sectional and built-in window seats, creating a comfortable place to unwind after a day at the beach. The first-floor primary suite provides a quiet haven with a king bed, walk-in closet, and spacious private bathroom that includes a double vanity, soaking tub, and open shower. From the primary suite and living area, step directly onto the screened porch, a peaceful outdoor retreat with a built-in natural gas grill and comfortable seating for evening gatherings. Upstairs, two queen bedrooms each include private bathrooms and direct access to a shared balcony overlooking the community lake, a tranquil spot for morning coffee or evening breezes. A third guest room offers a king bed and private bath. The upstairs common area includes a twin-over-twin bunk bed and an additional twin bed, providing a perfect hangout for kids or teens. With thoughtful design, generous living spaces, and both indoor and outdoor areas for connection, 100 Tumblehome Way makes it easy to relax, recharge, and make lasting memories along 30A.Sleeping Arrangements First Floor: Primary Bedroom: King Bed (Sleeps 2), Private Bathroom with Open Shower, Double Vanity, and Soaking Tub Laundry Room Half Bathroom Kitchen, Dining, and Living Areas Screened Porch Second Floor: Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed (Sleeps 2), Private Bathroom and Balcony Access Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed (Sleeps 2), Private Bathroom and Balcony Access Guest Bedroom: King Bed (Sleeps 2), Private Bathroom Common Area: Twin-Over-Twin Bunk Bed (Sleeps 2) and One Twin Bed (Sleeps 1) Life in WaterSound West Beach WaterSound West Beach offers a private, peaceful escape surrounded by natural beauty and coastal charm. This gated community borders Deer Lake State Park and features a zero-entry pool, fire pit, putting green, and scenic boardwalks leading to a private stretch of beach. Guests can take a leisurely bike ride or a quick electric cart trip to nearby favorites like The Big Chill or Seaside, then return to enjoy quiet evenings under the stars. Blending the serenity of nature with easy access to 30A’s best shopping and dining, WaterSound West Beach delivers the best of both worlds—tranquil coastal living with all the comforts of home.
